purpose: Measure detection and service recovery after one controlled AMF, SMF, or UPF Pod deletion in the accepted single-node local topology.

topology.availability_claim: Measured single-replica recovery; this is not high availability or zero-downtime service.

amf.expected_primary_blast_radius: N2 signalling, registration state, and mobility control

smf.expected_primary_blast_radius: PDU-session control and PFCP session management

upf.expected_primary_blast_radius: PFCP state, GTP-U forwarding, and both DNN user-plane paths

controls.fault_method: Delete the one exact selected Pod with the ordinary Kubernetes grace period and let its existing controller reconcile it.
controls.restoration_method: Run the platform dependency-ordered session repair after measurement, then require complete platform and observability stack validation.

timing.healthy_baseline: The last successful platform and observability stack validation before fault injection.
timing.fault_time: The UTC timestamp immediately before the Kubernetes Pod delete request.
timing.detection_time: The first Kubernetes API sample where the old Pod UID is absent or the Deployment has zero available replicas.
timing.infrastructure_recovery_time: The first sample where a replacement Pod with a different UID is Ready and its Deployment is available.
timing.automatic_service_recovery_time: The first post-fault sample satisfying the component recovery signals before operator repair.
timing.assisted_service_recovery_time: Completion of session repair and both platform and observability stack validation when automatic recovery did not restore the complete service.
timing.mttr: The applicable automatic or assisted service recovery time minus fault time. Pod readiness alone is never MTTR.

evidence.freshness_rule: A recovery gauge is eligible only when max(timestamp(metric)) or min(timestamp(metric)) proves the underlying source sample is at or after the fault boundary; the HTTP query evaluation timestamp is not used as metric freshness.
evidence.reviewed_data: generated only from a complete accepted campaign

secondary_safety_tests.mongodb_recreation: Recreate only the MongoDB Pod and prove the same PVC identity and five subscriber records remain.
secondary_safety_tests.invalid_configuration: Use Helm values-schema validation and a server-side dry run to reject an invalid five-UE contract without changing the release.
